scope: Material repairs in 8 patient/8 combined GLBs and 8 patient sources; bedspread-only transform in 3 room/8 combined GLBs and 3 room sources
findings: Opaque anatomy was incorrectly exported as BLEND/doubleSided, disabling depth writes in GLTFLoader.
Skin and cotton normals were pure black after color-space changes cleared generated pixels.
Legacy JPEG conversion removed eye atlas alpha, exposing the blue outer corneal surface.
repairs: OPAQUE front-facing anatomy; MASK .34 two-sided hair/brows/lashes.
Black normal references removed, corresponding unused tangent/accessor/image payloads safely pruned.
Only 980 outer eye-shell triangles use PatientEyeCorneaClear MASK .34 alpha0; iris/sclera remain OPAQUE.
Eight sources and generator use the same policies; future normal color space precedes pixel assignment and eye alpha uses PNG.
Room bedspread node raised .035 m, giving .032029 m minimum mattress clearance; no geometry/binary changes.
evidenceLimit: Cycles renders complement CPU/material checks; direct WebGL viewport pixels were unavailable in this environment.
